boundary: QNC is a news cutter: a laptop in the field with an HDMI monitor (user rule 2026-10-03). When a screen other than the main one is connected, this block shows on it, full screen, the confirmed picture the preview monitor paints (the monitor offers it), black when there is none; without one there is no window and no error, and a screen plugged in or out is followed every two seconds. The output screen is the largest screen that is not the main one, found through one adapter per OS (Windows: EnumDisplayMonitors; other OS: a controlled 'not supported yet', the output stays off). It owns no clock, decodes nothing, reads no database and does not know the application on screen; it follows the pictures the monitor gets at the pace the desktop paints. An output driven by the player clock (SDI/NDI, genlock) is a later adapter of the same contract.
